meaning_en: To say sorry for something you did.
example_en: I must apologise for my mistake.

meaning_en: Feeling unhappy or angry.
example_en: He is in a bad mood today.

meaning_en: To hit something hard, making a loud noise.
example_en: He accidentally banged his head on the low doorframe.

meaning_en: To stop something from moving or passing through.
example_en: A fallen tree blocked the road.

meaning_en: To stop working (for a machine or vehicle).
example_en: My car broke down on the way to work.

meaning_en: damaged and not working
example_en: My phone is broken.

meaning_en: a dark mark on skin from a hit
example_en: I got a bruise on my leg.

meaning_en: hit something accidentally
example_en: I bumped my head on the door.

meaning_en: be damaged by fire or heat
example_en: Be careful not to burn yourself.

meaning_en: A small piece of silicon in a computer.
example_en: This computer has a very fast chip.

meaning_en: To become separated from something.
example_en: The button came off my shirt.

meaning_en: An electronic machine for storing and processing data.
example_en: I use my computer for work.

meaning_en: When a computer suddenly stops working.
example_en: My computer crashed and I lost my work.

meaning_en: A line where something is broken but not separated.
example_en: There's a crack in the window.

meaning_en: To hit something hard, often causing damage.
example_en: The car crashed into a tree.

meaning_en: To press something so hard it breaks or deforms.
example_en: He accidentally crushed the empty can.

meaning_en: To divide something into pieces with a sharp tool.
example_en: Please cut the cake into slices.

meaning_en: No longer alive.
example_en: The plant is dead, I forgot to water it.

meaning_en: (n) A hollow mark on a surface; (v) to make a dent.
example_en: My car got a small dent in the parking lot.

meaning_en: To stop living.
example_en: My old dog died last year.

meaning_en: To drop to the ground, often accidentally.
example_en: The old wall might fall down soon.

meaning_en: To separate from something and drop.
example_en: The button fell off my shirt.

meaning_en: Moving or happening quickly.
example_en: He can run very fast.

meaning_en: Smooth and level, without curves or bumps.
example_en: The road was flat for many miles.

meaning_en: To cover with a large amount of water.
example_en: The river might flood the town.

meaning_en: to rub your skin and cause a slight injury.
example_en: I fell and grazed my knee.

meaning_en: To experience many problems or difficulties.
example_en: I had a bad day at work.

meaning_en: Have an angry argument with someone.
example_en: I had a row with my brother yesterday.

meaning_en: The place where you live.
example_en: I want to go home now.

meaning_en: Feeling unhappy or angry.
example_en: He is in a bad mood today, so be careful.

meaning_en: Arriving after the expected time.
example_en: I am always late for work.

meaning_en: A hole that lets liquid or gas escape.
example_en: There's a water leak in the roof.

meaning_en: To prevent someone from entering a place.

meaning_en: try to find something or someone.
example_en: I need to look for my keys.

meaning_en: no longer have something; misplace.
example_en: I always lose my keys.

meaning_en: To repair something that is broken.
example_en: Can you mend my torn shirt?

meaning_en: To put something somewhere and forget where.
example_en: I often mislay my keys.

meaning_en: how you feel at a particular time
example_en: I'm in a good mood today.

meaning_en: Not working correctly.
example_en: The lift is out of order.

meaning_en: a sticky strip to cover small cuts.
example_en: I put a plaster on my cut finger.

meaning_en: A period when the electricity supply stops.
example_en: We had a power cut last night.

meaning_en: To start wearing clothes or accessories.
example_en: I put on my coat before going outside.

meaning_en: To fix something that is broken.
example_en: Can you repair my broken bicycle?

meaning_en: A noisy argument or fight.

meaning_en: To damage something so badly it is destroyed.
example_en: The rain ruined our picnic plans.

meaning_en: To use all of something and have none left.
example_en: We've run out of milk.

meaning_en: Not fast.
example_en: The internet is very slow.

meaning_en: To break into many pieces violently.
example_en: He accidentally smashed the plate.

meaning_en: Accidentally make liquid flow out.
example_en: Be careful not to spill your drink.

meaning_en: A mark that is hard to remove.
example_en: I got a coffee stain on my shirt.

meaning_en: Begin to work or operate.

example_en: My car won't start this morning.

meaning_en: To no longer move or continue.
example_en: The car stopped suddenly.

meaning_en: neat and organized.
example_en: Please keep your room tidy.

meaning_en: More than is needed or wanted.
example_en: I have too much work to do.

meaning_en: A journey to a place and back again.
example_en: We went on a short trip to the beach.

meaning_en: Not neat or well-arranged.

meaning_en: To view television programs using the internet.
example_en: I often watch TV online on my laptop.

meaning_en: A clear liquid essential for life.
example_en: Please drink plenty of water every day.

meaning_en: To do a job.
example_en: I work in an office.
